item.title: Ginwoo Onodera Makes History at Street League Skateboarding
item.description: Huge congrats to Ginwoo Onodera! For the first time ever in Street League Skateboarding history, a skater scored 9+ on all seven trick attempts. All in the same day, Ginwoo turned 16, won SLS Sydney, and made history.
